plan_name: Hospital Appointment Booking System - MVP Execution Plan

tasks.title: Setup PostgreSQL database schema with users, patients, doctors, availability_slots, and appointments tables
Implement REST API authentication endpoints (register, login, logout) with JWT tokens and password hashing
Build patient registration and profile management UI screens with form validation
Develop doctor availability management API endpoints and database operations for time slot CRUD
Create doctor search and booking flow UI including search, filter, time slot selection, and confirmation screens
Implement appointment booking API with slot validation, conflict checking, and transaction handling
Build patient appointments list UI with filtering by status and appointment detail views
Develop doctor dashboard UI showing daily schedule, upcoming appointments, and patient details
Implement appointment cancellation API endpoints with slot release and status updates
Create database indexes on frequently queried columns (email, role, doctor_id, patient_id, status) for performance
Build responsive web layouts and mobile-first CSS for all core screens with accessibility compliance
Integrate frontend React components with backend API endpoints and implement error handling

risks: Time slot double-booking if concurrent requests are not properly handled with database transactions and locking
Performance degradation with large datasets if database queries are not optimized and indexed properly
Authentication security vulnerabilities if JWT implementation and password hashing are not correctly configured
Mobile responsiveness issues across different device sizes if testing is limited to single device type
Scope creep from stakeholders requesting notification features before core booking flow is stable
